image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a pair of feet wearing hand-knitted, multi-colored striped socks. The socks feature horizontal stripes in shades of purple, green, pink, and brown. They appear to be crew-length or ankle-length, resting on a light-colored wooden floor with visible grain.

To verify the continuous tubular structure of the knit and ensure no AI-generated melting or fusion occurs at the boundaries between the sock and skin or sock and floor.
To analyze the consistency of the knit pattern and yarn texture, checking for subtle AI artifacts like repeating noise patterns or inconsistent stitch geometry.
